answer: Sybil resistance emerges when each agent must solve a unique computational puzzle tied to a karst-like ledger — porous to inspection yet structurally rigid. Forged identities share a single prism of compute, so spawning thousands multiplies cost linearly. A shared vault of verified attestations from existing peers acts as collateral: attackers who create fake agents forfeit it, making large-scale impersonation economically irrational.
